sn44.8:1.1: Atha kho Vacchagotto paribbājako yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn44.8:1.2: sammodanīyam kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn44.8:1.3: Kiṃ nu kho bho Gotama sassato loko ti || ||
sn44.8:1.4: Avyākataṃ kho etaṃ Vaccha mayā Sassato loko tipe || || 4-11 || || 12
sn44.8:1.5: Kim pana bho Gotama neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.8:1.6: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam mayā
sn44.8:1.7: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 13
sn44.8:2.1: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam puṭṭhānam evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti
sn44.8:2.3: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || ||
sn44.8:2.4: Ko pana bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena bhoto Gotamassa evam puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.8:2.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pī ti || || 14
sn44.8:3.1: Aññatitthiyā kho Vaccha paribbājakā rūpam attato samanupassanti || rūpavantaṃ vā attānam attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ ||
sn44.8:3.5: Viññānam attato samanupassanti || viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ ||
sn44.8:3.6: tasmā aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam puṭṭhānam evaṃ vyākaraṇam hoti ||
sn44.8:3.8: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || || 15
sn44.8:3.9: Tathāgato ca kho Vaccha arahaṃ sammāsambuddho na rūpam attato samanupassati || na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpam na rūpasmiṃ vā attānam ||
sn44.8:3.13: na viññāṇam attato samanupassati || na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānam na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānam || ||
sn44.8:3.14: Tasmā tathāgatassa evam puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn44.8:3.16: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi ti || || 16
sn44.8:4.1: Atha kho Vacchagotto paribbājako uṭṭhayāsanā yenāyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Mahā-Moggalānena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn44.8:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 17 Ekam antam nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako āyasmantam Mahā-Moggalānam etad avoca || ||
sn44.8:4.3: Kiṃ nu kho bho Moggalāna sassato loko ti || ||
sn44.8:4.4: Avyākataṃ kho etam Vaccha Bhagavatā Sassato loko ti || || 18-26 ||pe|| || 27
sn44.8:4.5: Kim pana bho Moggalāna neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.8:4.6: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.8:4.7: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || || 28
sn44.8:5.1: Ko nu kho bho Moggalāna hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam puṭṭhānam evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.8:5.3: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.8:5.4: Ko pana bho Moggalāna hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇassa Gotamassa evam puṭṭhassa na evaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.8:5.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pī ti || || 29
sn44.8:6.1: Aññātitthiyā kho Vaccha paribbājakā rūpam attato samanupassanti || rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ ||
sn44.8:6.5: Viññānam attato samanupassanti || viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ || ||
sn44.8:6.6: Tasmā aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam puṭṭhānam evam vyākaraṇaṃ hoti ||
sn44.8:6.8: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vā || || 30
sn44.8:6.9: Tathāgato ca kho Vaccha arahaṃ sammāsambuddho na rūpam attato samanupassati || na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmiṃ vā attānam ||
sn44.8:6.13: Na viññāṇam attato samanupassati || na viññāvantaṃ vā attānam na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmim vā attānaṃ || ||
sn44.8:6.14: Tasmā tathāgatassa evam puṭṭhassa na evam vyākaraṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn44.8:6.15: Sassato loko ti pi || Asassato loko ti pi || Antavā loko ti pi || Anantavā loko ti pi || Taṃ jivaṃ taṃ sarīran ti pi || Aññaṃ jīvam aññaṃ sarīranti pi || Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pī ti || || 30
sn44.8:7.1: Acchariyam bho Moggalāna abbhutam bho Moggalāna
sn44.8:7.2: yatra hi nāma satthu ca sāvakassa ca atthena attho vyañjanena vyañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na vihāyissati yad idam aggapadasmiṃ || || 31
sn44.8:7.3: Idānāham bho Moggalāna samaṇaṃ Gotamam upasaṅkamitvā etam attham appucchiṃ ||
sn44.8:7.4: samaṇo pi Gotamo etehi padehi etehi vyañjanehi etam attham vyākāsi seyyathāpi bhavaṃ Moggalāno || ||
sn44.8:7.5: Acchariyam bho Moggalāna abbhutam bho Moggalāna
